林国强回到家的时候，赵素梅正坐在炕沿上等。

她听见院门响，站起来走到门口，看见林国强走进来，月光照在他身上，把他的影子拉得很长。

“怎么样了？”她问。

“我警告过他们了，让他们管好孩子。”

林国强脱下鞋，换上屋里穿的布鞋。

“大牛和二丫呢？他们愿意道歉了？”

“不情不愿的，但说了对不起。”

林国强走到炕边，把林静抱起来，在她脸上亲了一口，“静静，大牛和二丫给你道歉了。

以后他们再欺负你，你跟爸说。”

林静搂着他的脖子，点了点头。

赵素梅站在旁边，看着这一幕，心里忽然涌上一股热流。

她想起以前，林静被欺负的时候，林国强总是说“算了”。

她心里委屈，但不敢说，怕说了林国强不高兴，怕说了婆婆知道了又要骂她“挑拨离间”。

那时候她觉得，这个男人靠不住。

但现在不一样了。

现在她知道，这个男人靠得住。

他不会让任何人欺负他的孩子。

大人不行，小孩不行，谁都不行。

“素梅，”林国强忽然喊了她一声。

“嗯？”

“以后静静和薇薇的事，你不用一个人扛着。”

他看着她的眼睛，“有人欺负她们，你跟我说，我去解决。”

赵素梅的眼眶红了，但她没有哭，只是点了点头。

“睡吧，明天还得早起。”

林国强把林静放在炕上，盖好被子。

“嗯。”

灯灭了。

屋子里黑了下来，赵素梅躺在炕上，感受着林国强强有力的心跳声，听着林静和林薇均匀的呼吸声，心里安稳畅快。

“国强，”她突然喊他。

“嗯？”

“你以前不是这样的。”

“哪样？”

“以前静静被欺负，你总说算了，现在你不一样了。”

When Lin Guoqiang returned home, Zhao Sumei was sitting on the edge of the kang, waiting.

She heard the sound of the courtyard door, stood up and walked to the door, and saw Lin Guoqiang walking in. The moonlight shone on him, making his shadow long.

"How's it going?" she asked.

"I warned them to take care of their children."

Lin Guoqiang took off his shoes and put on the cloth shoes he wore in the house.

"Where are Daniel and Erya? Are they willing to apologize?"

"Reluctantly, but I said sorry."

Lin Guoqiang walked to the kang, picked up Lin Jing, and kissed her on the face, "Jingjing, Daniel and Erya apologized to you.

If they bully you again in the future, tell your dad."

Lin Jing hugged his neck and nodded.

Zhao Sumei stood nearby, watching this scene, and suddenly felt a surge of heat in her heart.

She remembered that in the past, when Lin Jing was bullied, Lin Guoqiang always said "forget it".

She felt aggrieved, but she didn't dare to say it, for fear that Lin Guoqiang would be unhappy if she told her, and that her mother-in-law would scold her for "stirring up discord" if she found out.

At that time, she felt that this man was unreliable.

But it's different now.

Now she knew that this man was reliable.

He won't let anyone bully his children.

Adults can't do it, children can't do it, no one can do it.

"Su Mei," Lin Guoqiang suddenly called her.

"Huh?"

"From now on, you don't have to take care of Jingjing and Weiwei's affairs alone."

He looked into her eyes and said, "Someone is bullying them. Tell me and I will solve it."

Zhao Sumei's eyes were red, but she didn't cry, she just nodded.

"Go to sleep, you have to get up early tomorrow."

Lin Guoqiang put Lin Jing on the kang and covered her with a quilt.

"Yeah."

The lights went out.

The room turned dark, and Zhao Sumei lay on the kang, feeling the strong heartbeat of Lin Guoqiang, and listening to the even breathing of Lin Jing and Lin Wei, feeling peaceful and happy.

"Guoqiang," she suddenly called him.

"Huh?"

"You weren't like this before."

"What kind?"

"Before Jingjing was bullied, you always said let it go, but now you are different."
